recreation_brief:
1. Set the base slide background to #E8E8E8.
2. Draw a rectangle covering the full slide (0-100% width and height): fill #D5D8DC, thin red border #C0392B (~2 pt). This is the slide panel.
3. Insert a text box spanning the full width, placed in the vertical 30-60% band, center-aligned. Type two lines in a large serif font, color #C0392B: line 1 'Mapping non-linearly Separable Data'; line 2 'to Higher Dimensions'.
4. In the top-right corner (approx. 95-100% from left, 0-5% from top), draw a circle filled #F39C12 and place the numeral '14' centered inside it, bold, color #2C3E50.
5. Draw a full-width thin rectangle along the bottom edge (approx. bottom 2% of slide height), filled black (#000000), no border.
6. Add nothing else: no bullets, images, charts, or extra text (this is a title-only slide). Leave the slide static with no animations.
